narrative.overview:
A white, airy page following the user-pinned references (adhamdannaway.com for the split face and soft cards, aaabadcode.com for the pastel fluid smoke). One oversized head, raised so more of the torso shows, stands in the centre of a single scene. Left of it thin pastel smoke follows the cursor (marketing); right of it syntax-coloured code lights up under the cursor beside floating tech chips (development). Everything below the hero is quiet so the portrait carries the identity.

Colour is rationed to two places: the smoke and the brand-coloured chips. Elsewhere the page is ink on white and pale grey. Depth comes from soft layered shadows and hairline rules. The page is static and light: Figtree self-hosted, no libraries, WebGL smoke loaded after load for fine pointers only, CSS blobs as fallback. The tech chips never touch the body: they sit in a loose, hand-placed-looking grid on each side of the photo.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, one pale band for projects, hairline dividers.
Single-scene hero: transparent portrait raised to -0.03 of hero height, side-faded on desktop; the title under the cursor leads.
Chips float in a loose two-row grid beside the portrait, hidden from 721px to 1100px.
Figtree variable for all human text; system mono only for code and stack lines.
White cards and minis, 12px radius, two-layer soft shadows, lift on hover when linked.
Stack groups: bordered 12px groups in a 3-column grid, six cells for seven groups (Herramientas and Producto stacked in one).
Spanish copy; nothing invented as proof.

rules.name: The Paint Rule
rules.body: Pastels live in the smoke. Elsewhere they are tiny marks only, never fills, buttons or card colours.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Brand colours appear only inside tech chips, as glyph colour on white.

rules.name: The Cool Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is ink or muted; no pure black text, no warm greys.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree for everything human-readable; mono only for literal code, stack names and repo names.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are layered, ink-tinted and low-opacity. No hard offset shadows, no coloured glows.

dos: Do keep pastel colour inside the smoke; keep brand colours inside white chips.
Do use ink and muted for text, line hairlines for structure.
Do give raised objects the Rest shadow; lift only linked cards and minis.
Do use cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for transitions and honour prefers-reduced-motion and (pointer: fine) for heavy effects.
Do keep interactive targets at least 44px tall and the 3px blue focus ring visible.
Do keep first load tiny: self-hosted Figtree, no libraries, smoke loaded after load.
Do keep chips outside the portrait and give each one its own small offset so the cluster reads as hand-placed.
donts: Don't fill buttons, cards or sections with the pastel accents.
Don't add dark themes or dark sections.
Don't use hard offset shadows, coloured glows or heavy borders.
Don't introduce a second text family or set prose in mono.
Don't invent proof (clients, metrics, testimonials) or link unlinked minis.
Don't use the middle dot as a separator in copy, titles or meta: use |, commas in lists and a short hyphen with spaces in date ranges.
